title: Synthesis of N-aminophalimides derived from alpha-amino acids: Theoretical study to find them as HDAC8 inhibitors by docking simulations and in vitro assays.
authors: Guzman Ramirez, Jose Eduardo; Mancilla Percino, Teresa
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成N-氨基邻苯二甲酰亚胺衍生物并通过分子对接和体外实验评估其对HDAC8酶的抑制活性，对象为小分子-蛋白质互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Phthalimides are valuable for synthesis and biological properties. New acetamides 3(a-c) and 4(a-c) were synthesized and characterized as precursors for novel N-aminophalimides 5(a-c) and 6(a-c). Structures of 4a, 5(a-b), and 6(a-b) were confirmed by single crystal X-ray. Docking studies identified compounds with favorable Gibbs free energy values for binding to histone deacetylase 8 (HDAC8), an enzyme targeted for anticancer drug development. These compounds bound to both the orthosteric and allosteric pockets of HDAC8, similar to Trichostatin A (TSA), an HDAC8 inhibitor. 6(a-c) contain hydroxyacetamide moiety as a zinc-binding group, a phthalimide moiety as a capping group, and aminoacetamide moiety as a linker group, which are important for ligand-receptor binding. DeltaG values indicated that compounds 5b, 6b, and 6c had higher affinity for HDAC8 in the allosteric pocket compared to TSA. In vitro evaluation of inhibitory activities on HDAC8 revealed that compounds 3(a-c) and 5(a-c) showed similar inhibitory effects (IC(50) ) ranging from 0.445 to 0.751 muM. Compounds 6(a-c) showed better affinity, with 6a (IC(50)  = 28 nM) and 6b (IC(50)  = 0.18 muM) showing potent inhibitory effects slightly lower than TSA (IC(50)  = 26 nM). These findings suggest that the studied compounds hold promise as potential candidates for further biological investigations.
abstract_zh: 邻苯二甲酰亚胺在合成和生物学性质方面具有重要价值。合成了新的乙酰胺类化合物3(a-c)和4(a-c)，并将其表征为新型N-氨基邻苯二甲酰亚胺5(a-c)和6(a-c)的前体。通过单晶X射线衍射确认了4a、5(a-b)和6(a-b)的结构。对接研究鉴定出具有有利吉布斯自由能值的化合物，这些化合物可与组蛋白去乙酰化酶8（HDAC8）结合，该酶是抗癌药物开发的靶点。这些化合物同时结合HDAC8的正构和变构口袋，类似于HDAC8抑制剂曲古抑菌素A（TSA）。6(a-c)含有作为锌结合基团的羟基乙酰胺部分、作为封端基团的邻苯二甲酰亚胺部分以及作为连接基团的氨基乙酰胺部分，这些对配体-受体结合至关重要。DeltaG值表明，化合物5b、6b和6c在变构口袋中对HDAC8的亲和力高于TSA。对HDAC8抑制活性的体外评估显示，化合物3(a-c)和5(a-c)表现出相似的抑制效果（IC(50)），范围在0.445至0.751 μM之间。化合物6(a-c)表现出更好的亲和力，其中6a（IC(50) = 28 nM）和6b（IC(50) = 0.18 μM）显示出强效抑制效果，略低于TSA（IC(50) = 26 nM）。这些发现表明，所研究的化合物有望成为进一步生物学研究的潜在候选物。
